description: This file defines a utility class 'Encoders' in the Spark network protocol module, providing encoding and decoding methods for simple data types such as Strings, Bitmaps, byte arrays, String arrays, int arrays, long arrays, and arrays of Bitmaps, primarily for serialization purposes.

classes.name: Encoders
classes.description: Provides static nested classes for encoding and decoding various simple data types for network transmission.

classes.name: Encoders.Strings
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of String objects with length prefix and UTF-8 encoding.

classes.name: Encoders.Bitmaps
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of RoaringBitmap objects with size prefix, including bitmap compression.

classes.name: Encoders.ByteArrays
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of byte arrays with length prefix.

classes.name: Encoders.StringArrays
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of String arrays with count prefix.

classes.name: Encoders.IntArrays
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of int arrays with length prefix.

classes.name: Encoders.LongArrays
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of long arrays with length prefix.

classes.name: Encoders.BitmapArrays
classes.description: Handles encoding and decoding of arrays of RoaringBitmap objects with count prefix.

methods.name: encodedLength
methods.description: Calculates the byte length needed to encode the data type.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the data type into a ByteBuf.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the data type from a ByteBuf.
